title: Design System: Azira Aesthetics concern pages

derivedColors.name: plate
derivedColors.purpose: Dark placeholder ground for treatment stills and results.

derivedColors.name: plate-ink
derivedColors.purpose: Placeholder text and outline on dark plates.

inputs: radius (CSS length; drives the radius scale)
fonts recorded in brand.ts, loaded in content/<clinic>/fonts.ts

display.purpose: Hero headline only: 2.25rem / 3rem / 3.75rem / 4.25rem at xl, max 16ch. The closing ask runs one step larger (2.5rem / 3.75rem / 4.5rem).

title.purpose: Cause titles, treatment names, panel and form titles: 1.75rem to 2rem.

body-lead.purpose: Section intros, 44 to 48ch; hero intro 1.25rem at lg.

body.purpose: Running copy in charcoal, 32 to 48ch in blocks, 65ch in FAQ answers.

label.purpose: Tracked uppercase caption under plates, on credentials, spec terms, price prefixes and axis labels. Never a kicker.

button.purpose: CTA labels; case and tracking come from the brand via brand-label.

shadows.name: focus-stroke
shadows.purpose: Doubles a 1px border on focused inputs and selects, and on checked choice cards.

shadows.name: arrival-ring
shadows.purpose: Ring on the enquiry card when a Book button arrives, fading to transparent over 1.2s after a 0.5s delay.

shadows.name: floating-list
shadows.purpose: Select popover; the only lift in the system.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: The one easing for every moment.

motion.name: fade-up
motion.value: opacity 0 to 1, translateY 12px to 0, 400ms, once at 15% in view
motion.purpose: Section entrance below the hero. Never on the hero headline, image or form.

motion.name: bar-slide
motion.purpose: Mobile Call/Book bar entering once the hero buttons scroll away, and leaving while the form is on screen.

motion.name: success-swap
motion.value: form exit opacity 0 and -8px in 200ms; thank-you enter from 8px in 400ms
motion.purpose: Replaces the enquiry form in place on success.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Button and input colour and border changes.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: MotionConfig reducedMotion="user"; smooth scroll only with no-preference
motion.purpose: Movement drops to opacity only when the user asks for reduced motion.

narrative.overview:
The page is a white gallery wall. The clinic's own photographs (gloved hands, instruments, the treatment room) hang on it as plates. Each plate carries a tracked uppercase wall label, and the copy sits beside the pictures like wall text. A dark photo-backed band opens the page, deep "dark room" bands recur where the framework calls for them, and warm grey panels hold the quiet material: the form, the clinician, the steps. The tone is precise and clinical: hairline rules, square corners, one solid action per band, and a light-weight rounded display face so the precision never turns severe.

This is a multi-clinic template. Each clinic's `content/<clinic>/brand.ts` supplies every value: colours, radius, button label case and tracking, and (through `content/<clinic>/fonts.ts`) the two faces. `lib/brand-style.ts` injects these as `--brand-*` variables on `<html>`, and `app/globals.css` maps them onto semantic tokens. Components use only the semantic tokens, so a new clinic is re-branded without touching a component. The values in the frontmatter are Azira Aesthetics', the current instance. Pages are light only (`color-scheme: light`).

The world was built to avoid the beauty-clinic default of a blush split hero with a smiling model and a row of icon cards. Imagery is never stock (a hard rule in CLAUDE.md). Until the clinic supplies photos, every plate renders a marked placeholder naming the file it needs.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, near-black display type, charcoal body text, 1px rules.
Three tonal grounds carry all the depth: white surface, warm grey panel, dark room.
Square corners (Azira's radius is 0) on buttons, inputs, plates and panels.
Every photograph is a plate with a wall label bound tight beneath it.
Champagne gold appears only as hairlines, the award mark and gold text.
Motion is quiet: section fade-ups once, a sliding phone action bar, and two form moments.

rules.name: The Gold-as-Hairline Rule
rules.body: The accent is a 1px rule, an award mark or gold text, never a fill, a button or a background. On light grounds, gold text always uses `accent-ink`.

rules.name: The Three Grounds Rule
rules.body: Every band is one of three grounds: surface, panel or room. A new section picks one of these and never introduces a fourth tint.

rules.name: The Light Hand Rule
rules.body: Display and headline type stays at the heading face's regular weight (400) at every size. Hierarchy comes from size and space, never from bold.

rules.name: The Wall Label Rule
rules.body: The tracked caption labels something that is present: a plate, a data term, a price, an axis. It is never a free-floating kicker above a heading.

rules.name: The Flat Wall Rule
rules.body: Bands, cards, plates and panels never cast shadows. Only something that floats above the page (a select list, a dialog) may lift.

rules.name: The Ruled Ledger Rule
rules.body: Lists, specs, credentials, steps and FAQs are ledgers: a 1px rule in `text` across the top, then `hairline` row dividers. Cards with borders on all four sides are not used for lists.

dos: Do route every colour, radius and button label style through the semantic tokens, so a clinic's `brand.ts` can restyle the page without a component change.
Do keep each band to one solid action: `ink` primary on light grounds, inverse white on room bands, with an outlined Call beside it.
Do bind a 0.75rem tracked uppercase wall label (0.2em) directly under every plate, 8px below it.
Do build lists as ruled ledgers: a 1px `text` top rule, then `hairline` rows (`room-ink` at 15–40% on room bands).
Do set headlines in the heading face at 400 weight with tight leading (1.05–1.12) and balanced wrapping.
Do use `accent-ink` for any gold text or icon on a light ground; `accent` itself is for rules and room-band text only.
Do keep the hero, its photo and the form still on load. Animate only sections below the fold, once.
donts: Don't use stock photography or a smiling-model split hero. Plates show the clinic's own hands, instruments and rooms.
Don't use gold as a fill, a button colour or a background.
Don't add shadows to bands, plates, cards or buttons. Depth comes from the surface, panel and room grounds.
Don't add a site menu, or a button that leaves the page.
Don't put a tracked caption above a heading as a kicker or eyebrow.
Don't introduce a second easing curve or animate on load above the fold.
